prompts.prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: transparent 2D top-down game sprite construction kit for ANIMOL Starway Ranch V02. Match the ranch reference style previously inspected: very bold crisp near-black navy exterior outline, angular long straight edges, wedge and trapezoid planes, completely flat solid base color plus one polygonal shadow, two or three tones per material. Cream timber, emerald green, mint and sage foliage, golden yellow, deep purple slate. Orthogonal square floor-plane plus a short front face, no isometric diamond perspective. True transparent alpha background. No text, labels, letters, numerals, UI, frame, grid, people, animals, stars, planets, moon. No gradients, airbrush, painterly texture, grain, realistic 3D, soft rounded shapes or circular fasteners. Each isolated component must be separated from other components by abundant transparent padding, and fully shown uncut. This is NEW native art, not an edit or recolor of another theme. Primary request: one 1536x1024 landscape modular CREAM RANCH FENCE kit. Four isolated components in a loose 2x2 layout. UPPER LEFT: a long straight horizontal two-rail fence carrier, cream wood with broad emerald green inset faces and tiny angular gold joinery accents, NO posts, no end caps, no feet, transparent spaces between the two rails. UPPER RIGHT: the same orthogonal vertical two-rail carrier viewed from above, long upright rectangular strips, NO posts or end caps. LOWER LEFT: one tall square cream fence post, faceted emerald pyramidal cap, emerald lower band, short square foot, all square/trapezoid geometry; no cylindrical parts. LOWER RIGHT: a compact square emerald-and-cream junction cap which stylistically matches the post. The straight carriers have bold silhouettes and do not taper with perspective; their middle sections can be cropped and extended seamlessly. Horizontal upper-left component spans roughly x50..1120, y130..390; vertical upper-right component x1200..1430,y40..600; tall post roughly x240..600,y540..970; lower-right junction roughlyx850..1120,y650..900. Do not draw actual numbers or layout guides.
